summary: Add a bbcode table format so tables can be pasted into forums that use BBCode.
behaviour: `tabulate(..., tablefmt="bbcode")` writes `[table]` on the first line, `[/table]` on the last, and one `[tr]...[/tr]` line per row in between, the header row first.
Header cells are `[th]...[/th]` and data cells `[td]...[/td]`, with no padding inside the tags.
In cell text, `&` becomes `&`, `[` becomes `[` and `]` becomes `]`, so no cell can open or close a tag. Every other character, including `<`, `>` and quotes, is written as it is.
A line break inside a cell is written as `[br]`.
An empty table renders as an empty string, as with the other formats.

entries: - Changed: The html format escapes cell text through a private helper, so htmlescape is no longer a module attribute. (feature/5d02c1)
- Changed: Multiline cells are folded into rows in every format except the ones listed in single_line_formats, so github, the outline formats and dokuwiki now fold them. (feature/c41f90)

entry: - Added: A bbcode table format for pasting tables into forums. ({branch})

main_commits.message: Stop exporting htmlescape from the module
Fold multiline cells in every format that is not single-line
